before: Issue #601 -- the serial number this asset's maker gave it, one line. Kept trimmed with runs of spaces collapsed and its case as typed, and blank where it has none -- the app writes null to clear it. At most 50 characters, app-enforced. Two assets of one Category cannot hold one serial number, compared without regard to case or surrounding spaces; a Deleted asset does not count and a Retired one does. The app reads the base again as it saves and refuses, naming the asset that holds it (lib/assetSerial.js). Written, changed and cleared on the asset's page by a site manager on the asset's Job in any status the app shows, as Note is (#612, lib/assetStatus.js:mayWriteDetailsIn); read by everyone else. NOT AN EVENT: changing it appends no Asset Log row and moves neither Status nor Job. The Equipment & Tools list's search finds an asset by it at any job, and its export carries it. Made by scripts/import/add_serial_number_601.mjs on both bases.
